mechanism: Fluconazole may increase atovaquone absorption variability and potentially inhibit metabolism, while atovaquone absorption is highly dependent on gastric pH and fat content; fluconazole can alter GI conditions affecting atovaquone bioavailability.
action: Monitor atovaquone efficacy closely; ensure adequate fat intake with atovaquone dosing; consider therapeutic drug monitoring if available; separate dosing if possible and maintain consistent administration with meals.
